h1: Val d'Isère ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Val d'Isère sits at 1,849 metres at the head of the Tarentaise, and the skiing above it runs to over 3,400: 71 lifts and 300 kilometres of marked runs, split by the operator into 23 green, 67 blue, 41 red and 29 black. The season is one of the longest in the Alps - 28 November 2026 to 2 May 2027 - and the snowpark sits at 2,500 metres on the back of Bellevarde.
stayOverview: The main village sits along one road with the Bellevarde and Solaise lifts at either end; La Daille is the gateway hamlet at the bottom, and Le Fornet is the quiet old village up the valley.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The village centre puts you between both main lifts; La Daille and Le Fornet are cheaper.
rentalCars: Val d'Isère is at the top of the Tarentaise above Bourg-Saint-Maurice, about three hours from Geneva.

dayPass.note: One day on the Tignes-Val d'Isère area, adults 19 to 64, from 12 December 2026 to 23 April 2027. It is EUR 67.00 in the early and late season. A Val d'Isère-only day, on its own 150 km, is EUR 70.00 in winter and EUR 60.00 either side.
